notes: Random well-formed scripts: every opcode 0..0x80 leads one case, then random blocks, with forward skips over executable blocks, nested sub-scripts two levels deep, inline texts, word lists and the format check (0x20 or a re-read opcode). Opcodes above 0x80 are left out because the original retries them forever. All callees and the text handler/hooks are logging stubs; the slot lookup returns slot addresses, the timer returns 0/1/random and the point measure stores a random distance. Random page record (entries 0..7), point data, distance, state byte, mode mask and handler (0xa0b5c or another).
